[CORRECTED during Lane 2b codex round-2 remediation, 2026-08-06: the question was originally an UNQUOTED, unadjacent-to-a-kind-noun lowercase slug ('What's the status of meridin/web-app?'). Per question_interpreter.py's test_context_refs_are_used_only_when_the_question_names_nothing, a question extract_mentions treats as naming NOTHING (which this unquoted-lowercase form is, same bug as every other bare-slug case fixed this round) is exactly the condition under which the interpreter falls back to any supplied request context_refs -- so the original phrasing risked silently testing context-fallback resolution instead of typo tolerance, a codex finding (medium). Quoting the misspelled slug ('repo "meridin/web-app"') makes extract_mentions treat it as a REAL, explicitly-named mention (quoting requires no capitalization/correct-spelling -- _QUOTED accepts any content) that actually reaches catalog lookup, where the genuine question -- does an exact-string catalog lookup tolerate a one-character edit -- is what determines the outcome, isolated from the unrelated extraction-syntax and context-fallback questions.
